label: Text 1
transcript: "Hello everyone, welcome to the snack table! In September I couldn't bake bread. Now I can bake scones. They are tastier than my first attempts. Tomorrow we are going to sell them for one euro each. Please come and try one!"

label: Text 2
transcript: "At the festival there will be six stalls: a bookshop, a snack table, a music corner, a games stand, a treasure-hunt stall, and a photography booth. The festival starts at 4 p.m. and ends at 7 p.m."
